t_n_out_1d.definition: count of outgoing transactions on day d

t_n_in_1d.definition: count of incoming transactions on day d

t_amt_out_1d.definition: sum of outgoing amounts on day d

t_amt_in_1d.definition: sum of incoming amounts on day d

t_max_out_1d.definition: largest outgoing amount on day d

t_max_in_1d.definition: largest incoming amount on day d

t_mean_out_1d.definition: mean outgoing amount on day d (0 if none)

t_std_out_1d.definition: std of outgoing amounts on day d (dispersion)

t_n_out_7d.definition: outgoing count, trailing 7 days incl. d

t_n_in_7d.definition: incoming count, trailing 7 days incl. d

t_n_transfer_out_1d.definition: outgoing transactions of type transfer on day d

t_n_transfer_in_1d.definition: incoming transactions of type transfer on day d

t_n_deposit_1d.definition: transactions of type deposit (either direction) on day d

t_n_withdrawal_1d.definition: transactions of type withdrawal (either direction) on day d

t_n_payment_1d.definition: transactions of type payment (either direction) on day d

t_transfer_share_7d.definition: share of transfers among all transactions, trailing 7 days

t_night_share_1d.definition: share of day-d transactions between 00:00 and 05:59

t_out_in_ratio_1d.definition: log((1+out amount)/(1+in amount)) on day d

b_new_cp_out_1d.definition: outgoing counterparties first seen on day d

b_new_cp_in_1d.definition: incoming counterparties first seen on day d

b_new_cp_share_1d.definition: new counterparties / transactions on day d

b_recip_cp_cum.definition: counterparties with transfers in both directions observed up to day d

b_z_out_amt.definition: z-score of day-d outgoing amount vs the previous 30 days

b_z_out_cnt.definition: z-score of day-d outgoing count vs the previous 30 days

b_velocity_ratio.definition: day-d transaction count / (mean daily count of previous 30 days + 0.1)

b_top_cp_share_1d.definition: largest counterparty's share of day-d outgoing amount

b_active_days_30d.definition: days with any activity in trailing 30 days

g_reach2_7d.definition: accounts within 2 hops in the 7-day undirected window graph

g_nbr_mean_deg_7d.definition: mean degree of neighbours in the 7-day window graph

g_nbr_act_1d.definition: mean day-d transaction count of neighbours

g_triangles_7d.definition: undirected triangles through the account, 7-day window graph

m_cycle2_7d.definition: directed 2-cycles (reciprocal pairs) through the account, 7-day graph

m_cycle4_7d.definition: directed 4-cycles (closed walks of length 4) through the account, 7-day graph

m_fanin_burst_3d.definition: max over last 3 days of distinct incoming counterparties in one day

m_fanout_burst_3d.definition: max over last 3 days of distinct outgoing counterparties in one day

m_passthrough_3d.definition: min(in,out)/max(in,out) amount over the last 3 days (rapid pass-through)

m_near10k_7d.definition: transactions with amount in [9000,10000), trailing 7 days

m_near10k_1d.definition: transactions with amount in [9000,10000) on day d

reason_labels.VELOCITY: Rapid change in activity vs recent history
reason_labels.DEVIATION: Deviation from the account's own history
